verdict.rationale: Lium's pod-creation docs describe a toggle that provisions a Jupyter notebook on the pod, which covers the Jupyter half of the story. The pack has no evidence of a one-step VS Code or Cursor remote connection. missing for 10: documented one-step VS Code/Cursor connection, detail on how the Jupyter notebook is accessed (URL/auth), hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open Jupyter or connect my IDE (VS Code/Cursor) to the instance in one step

citations.quote: Turn it on to get a Jupyter notebook on the pod.
